messages:
alex: Heads up — dedicated pool 'dc-eu-03' is showing a sustained throughput drop starting ~10:25 UTC. RPS down ~30%, tail p95/p99 up ~5x, and we're seeing intermittent 503s. Looks coincident with an autoscaler flip. Short logs attached.

alex: Logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T10:25:12Z] pool=dc-eu-03 queue_depth=78 processing_tokens=4096 max_batch_tokens=2048 scheduled=32
[2026-03-17T10:25:13Z] WARN throttle: tenant=team-alpha batch_size=1 wait=120ms
[2026-03-17T10:25:14Z] INFO akka.scheduler assign job_id=job_443 pool=dc-eu-03 seq_len=2048
```

alex: Repro curl: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"rwd-4b","prompt":"hello"}'` — sometimes returns 503 or hangs a few hundred ms before 503. @samir can you take a look? :eyes:

maria: Oncall here, checking. Any recent config pushes or rollouts?

infra-bot: Autoscaler event: pool dc-eu-03 decreased target_nodes 48 -> 12 at 2026-03-17T10:24:58Z due to node drain in az-west-1. Drained nodes: 36.

samir: Looking at batch histograms for dc-eu-03: huge skew to tiny microbatches.
```
batch_size_distribution:
  1: 62%
  2: 12%
  3-15: 18%
  16-255: 5%
  >=256: 3%
GPU utilization: 18% (expected ~74%)
```

samir: Hypothesis: continuous-batcher 'max_batch_tokens' was lowered on this pool during a config push earlier this morning (2048). With long-seq requests we're splitting into many tiny batches which kills throughput and increases scheduler churn. Also autoscaler stepped down capacity while queue_depth was still moderate which worsened queuing.

gina: CS reported AcmeCorp complaining about increased latency and unexpected token billing spike. They've opened an incident with support. We need a mitigation ASAP — customer impact.

samir: Quick mitigation plan: bump continuous-batcher.max_batch_tokens back to 8192 for dc-eu-03 and increase scheduler.quantum to reduce preemption. Running rolling change now:
```
redwoodctl pool update dc-eu-03 --set continuous_batcher.max_batch_tokens=8192
redwoodctl scheduler tune --pool dc-eu-03 --set quantum=128
```

samir: Also triggering a soft rebalance to move long-seq tenants off the smallest nodes while the pool recovers.

alex: After the change RPS recovered to ~95% of baseline and tail p99 dropped substantially within two minutes. No more 503s in the sample window. Keeping monitors on. :thumbsup:

maria: Followups: 1) prevent autoscaler from scaling below baseline when queue_depth > 50; 2) add alert on batch_size_skew > 50%; 3) require a config preflight for continuous-batcher.max_batch_tokens changes. Assign samir + infra.

samir: I'll file a postmortem ticket and add a preflight policy. Will also add a small e2e smoke that simulates long-seq load before config merges.

gina: I'll update the customer with a mitigation summary and next steps.

alex: Closing loop here once postmortem and billing reconciliation are done. Thanks everyone.
